units.pump_gal_per_mo: gal/month (groundwater supplied, well only, depletes water table)
units.retention_percent: % of monthly rainfall captured that would otherwise run off (ditch/berm only)
units.water_need_gal_per_mo: gal/month irrigation demand per tree (mesquite only)
units.rainfall_reference_gal_per_mo: gal/month rainfall on 2-acre plot used for balance math

sim_baseline.starting_manhours_note: Opening labor grant covers exactly the 40 mh house build (player starts with no workforce; house must come first). Well L1 and later builds are paid from the 160 mh/mo the house provides.
sim_baseline.rain_note: Fixed reference value for balance math (Q11: no RNG). Represents average capturable rainfall on the 2-acre plot. Actual biome pack (#6) may vary this seasonally; tuning holds at this reference.
sim_baseline.turn1_build_order: house (paid from 40 mh starting grant) -> well L1 -> ditch/berm -> mesquite (house must come first: grant covers exactly its 40 mh)

balance_check_monthly.money_per_mo_note: Pre-yield (months 1-11): -80 house food -15 well energy = -95/mo. Mature (month 12+): -95 + 4x$12 mesquite yield = -47/mo (slight burn, pressure to scale).
balance_check_monthly.water_per_mo_gal_note: +2500 pump + (50 base + 2x120 swale capture) - 4x250 tree demand = +1790 surplus

items.name: House
items.notes: Provides 160 mh/mo (1 farmer). Upkeep 8 mh/mo repairs + $80/mo food. Net +152 mh/mo. Must be built first (40 mh starting grant covers exactly this build).

items.name: Well L1
items.notes: Pumps 2500 gal/mo from water table (depletes reserve). Upkeep 4 mh/mo + $15/mo energy. Supports ~10 mesquite at 250 gal/mo each.

items.name: Ditch / Berm (100 ft swale)
items.notes: Retains +12% of monthly rainfall per unit (additive, cap 60% total). At 1000 gal/mo reference rain = +120 gal/mo effective capture. Upkeep 2 mh/mo desilting. No energy cost.

items.name: Mesquite (per tree)
items.notes: Native Sonoran tree. Plant 2 mh, upkeep 1 mh/mo pruning. Demands 250 gal/mo irrigation (rain capture offsets). Yields $12/mo pods/wood from month 12. Removing dead/alive tree costs 1 mh (per #1).
